title: Say Maples ya Manag-awit na Trono
intro: Diad palasyo na sakey a makapanyarin manuley, sakey ya imposiblin kerew so ginawa, tan dakel so nanlalaban pian paneknekan so kablian da. Balet, say kimey et nagawaan labat na sakey a say koneksion to ed madibinon pikakabat et onlampas ed amin a pisikal a dunong, ya mangiparungtal na sakey a bekta ya onaingal ed loob na saray panaon.
clues: Wala ak ed serbisyo na sakey a baleg ya ari ya sakey met a propeta, tan kaiba ak ed limog na saray sankapanmatalkan to.
Aliwa ak ya pinalsa na apoy odino sakey a pinalsan walaan na baleg a biskeg ed laman, balet ta walay sankabembenan kon mas makapanyari.
Nen kinerew na ari ya mangawit na trono manlapud arawin bansa, amtak lan maong no antoy gawaen ko.
Sinalita ko so pikakabat ya walad siak manlapud Libro, tan antis ya walay onkiwas, say trono so inyan ed arap na ari.
Say ginawak et aliwan lapud pakayarik, noagta sakey a panangipatnag ya say tuan pikakabat et manlalapud si Allah labat.
Siak so angiyakar ed trono na Reyna na Sheba diad sakey a kirem na mata, unong ed nisulat ed Surah An-Naml.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Samay walaan na pikakabat ed Libro
identity.answer: Samay walaan na pikakabat ed Libro

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangiyakar ed trono na Reyna na Sheba ed sakey a kirem
Say pangibiig ed Ambalangan Dayat parad saray Israelita
Manpapaalagey na Kaaba a kaiba toy anak to
Say pakaliktar ed eges na balyena
trial.answer: Say pangiyakar ed trono na Reyna na Sheba ed sakey a kirem

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say trono so pinmatnag a tampol ed arap nen Sulayman bilang subok na pisasalamat
Say reyna et tampol ya inawat toy Islam
Say jinn et nipriso lapud ag-inmabobon
Insuko nen Sulayman so panarian to
outcome.answer: Say trono so pinmatnag a tampol ed arap nen Sulayman bilang subok na pisasalamat

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
